name: Deckmon
description:
About This Game

Game Description:

  • Deckmon is a card-based strategy roguelite game inspired by the card game Blackjack. You’ll take on the role of a Deckmon Trainer, commanding your three Deckmons in battles against other Deckmons, challenging the five major league gyms, and ultimately defeating the league champion to become a Deckmon Master!

  • You must strategically assemble your Deckmon team, purchase appropriate Trainer gear, skill decks, and card decks, and devise your own tactical plan to ultimately defeat and capture a wide variety of powerful Deckmons, ascending to the ultimate throne.

Game Features:

  • Build your own battle deck using playing cards, skill cards, Trainer gear, and the unique abilities of your deployed Deckmons.

  • With 200 Deckmons of diverse attributes, you can create a rich battle lineup, and there are corresponding Shiny Deckmons waiting for you to collect.

  • Challenge the five Deckmon Gyms—Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth—and collect all five Gym Badges to unlock challenges against the Elite Four and the League Champion.
